description: Licences of data to AI companies disclosed since July 2023: licensor, licensee, content, use (training or display), term, value where disclosed, with a verbatim quote and the source. Newest first.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 10, at most 50).

query.description: Words that must all appear, such as a licensor, a licensee ("OpenAI") or a kind of content ("news").

since.description: Only deals on or after this date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

use.description: What the data is used for.

name: search_deals
title: Search disclosed AI data licensing deals
